title: Tatoeba English sentences available under CC0
usage: Auxiliary exact or normalized phrase-occurrence evidence only. Do not copy source sentences into product examples and do not treat this volunteer corpus as a representative exam-frequency corpus.
limitations: The CC0 subset is not a balanced learner or examination corpus.
Raw occurrence counts cannot determine junior, senior-high or CET-4 level.
Sentence quality varies, so occurrence evidence must be combined with lexical and stage evidence.
